'''March 2001 Centerville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Shumer's card store, Centerville, Ohio on 24 March 2001. [[Matt Scott]] won it. It is known from Tyler Martin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1945">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-centerville-ohio-3-24-01d1945/ centerville-ohio-3-24-01], DeckTech (Tyler "231" Martin, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-centerville-ohio-3-24-01d1945/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Shumer's card store, Centerville, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Scott]]
